summary: HCI Group filed an 8-K Item 1.01 disclosing a compensation plan for non-employee directors established by the compensation committee on June 11, 2026. Each director receives $100,000 per year in cash plus 750 restricted common shares, vesting on May 27, 2027, with dividend and ownership rights during restriction. This is a routine director compensation arrangement, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a standard current report for a material definitive agreement of a compensatory nature. No further action or risk-arb angle exists.
